query: What signals are linked to longer resolution duration values?

per_column.name: resolution_duration_seconds
per_column.rationale: This is the target variable itself, derivable from opened_at/closed_at timestamps. Central to the query on resolution duration; enables direct modeling and correlation.

per_column.name: resolution_duration_tier
per_column.rationale: Bucketing of duration into short/medium/long/very_long gives a clean grouping axis for comparing signals. Grounded as a transform of the duration; sample tiers align with the second values shown.

per_column.name: priority_numeric
per_column.rationale: Numeric encoding of the existing priority column; a plausible driver of resolution duration and useful for modeling. Well grounded in the priority field.

per_column.name: opened_hour
per_column.rationale: Hour extracted from opened_at; a legitimate temporal signal that could correlate with duration. Sample values match timestamps exactly.

per_column.name: is_off_hours_open
per_column.rationale: Off-hours flag derived from opened_hour; reasonable signal for duration. Note row 3 (17:40) flagged 0 while row 2 (18:14) flagged 1, suggesting a defined threshold; generally consistent though partly redundant with opened_hour.

per_column.name: assignee_avg_resolution_seconds
per_column.rationale: Per-assignee historical mean resolution time; a strong grouped signal for the query. Derivable by aggregating over closed_by/assigned_to within the table; values are group-level constants consistent with samples.

per_column.name: category_avg_resolution_seconds
per_column.rationale: Per-category mean resolution time; useful grouped signal derivable from category aggregation. Consistent across samples.

per_column.name: is_high_severity
per_column.rationale: Near-constant (474 vs 26) and largely redundant with priority_numeric, so limited analytical leverage. Derivable from priority but adds little new axis.

judge.rationale: Most added columns provide genuine, distinct axes (duration target, tiers, priority, temporal hour, per-assignee and per-category averages) directly relevant to identifying signals linked to longer resolution. Values are sound transforms/aggregations of present fields and match the row evidence. is_high_severity is weak (near-constant and redundant with priority), but per scope rules this does not drag down the overall set much. No hallucinations observed.
